build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (see that plugin's registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json` cannot run in this workspace). The trailing cp calls reproduce the `assets` globs the retired tsc build executor copied; the rest of that spec (README/CHANGELOG/llms.txt/drizzle/package.json) is owned by the inferred `assets` target.

test.//: Override of the inferred `test` target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference). main-entry-symlink.test.ts spawns the BUILT dist/src/server.js, which `require`s ../package.json — emitted by the inferred `assets` target and reached transitively through `dist-manifest` ([build, assets]). targetDefaults.test builds only DEPENDENCIES (`^build`) plus `lint`, never this project's OWN dist/, so `build` + `dist-manifest` are declared here. `lint`/`^build` are repeated because an explicit dependsOn replaces the targetDefault rather than merging with it.
